similar_scenes.author: Javier Blánquez (ed.)
similar_scenes.desc: Una región imprecisa del underground online que difumina las fronteras entre techno, house, ambient, dub, ruido y hasta rap: autoediciones, casetes y Bandcamp. Giegling (Traumprinz / Prince of Denmark), Diagonal (Powell), Opal Tapes (Huerco S.), Northern Electronics, L.I.E.S. de Ron Morelli, Lobster Theremin, Actress (Hazyville), Laurel Halo, Nicolas Jaar, Floating Points, Dean Blunt, patten.
